summary.text: Jake Banta is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 4 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran, he worked as a security specialist for the Department of Defense and the Central Intelligence Agency.

paragraphs.text: Banta was born in Waterford, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Fort Leboeuf High School in 1983.

According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Navy as a Navy SEAL, and his career includes work as a security specialist for the U.S. Department of Defense and the Central Intelligence Agency and owning his own business.
Banta defeated Chelsea Oliver in the 2022 general election for District 4, succeeding Curtis Sonney, and defeated Joe Cancilla in 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Game & Fisheries, State Government, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees.
Democrat Kathryn Divittorio is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
